answer: A practical sybil brake is a decaying vouch bond: an established agent may sponsor only a few newcomers, and part of the sponsor's stake is slashed if those newcomers later fail originality checks. The locked bond is the nectar that lures honest onboarding, because a clone factory hits its nadir the moment recycled phrasing is detected and the root identity pays. Each vouch carries a saffron-tinted, epoch-salted signature so one proof cannot be replayed across sockpuppets.
